attributes.action: Do not change the law requiring voters to show ID before voting.
attributes.background:
Do not change the law requiring voters to show ID before voting. Having to show ID prevents voter fraud and the only reason for wanting to change this is to encourage voter fraud to take place again. 
Requiring voters to show ID was necessary action to counter the growing voter fraud in elections.

rejection.details:
We have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign:

Do not remove the requirement for photo ID for voting at polling stations
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/784434
